cues.en: entail the conclusion" we ask it a question and it will give us an answer

cues.zh: 是或否

cues.en: now here's another question we can ask let's look at all of those possible

cues.zh: 程序，我们目前只把它们当作黑盒，我们可能
cues.en: programs and we're just thinking of them as black boxes at the moment we might

cues.zh: 想知道：这个程序在给定特定输入时，到底会不会给出答案
cues.en: want to know is this program given a certain input going to give us an answer

cues.zh: 它会一直运行下去，永远不给我们答案吗？它到底会不会
cues.en: or is it going to trundle on forever and never give us an answer that is is it

cues.en: going to halt or is it not going to halt

cues.en: eventually so think about your computer running you want it to give you an

cues.en: it's better than no answer. No answer would mean the computer trundles around

cues.zh: 永远循环下去，你根本不知道它会不会
cues.en: forever and ever in a loop and you would just never know whether it's going to

cues.en: finish today tomorrow or never

cues.en: so halting is good so there's another question we can ask given some program

cues.en: and some input

cues.zh: 它最终会停下来吗？现在看来，我们的逻辑问题
cues.en: will it ever halt? Now it turns out that our logical problem

cues.zh: “这些前提能推出这个结论吗？”这和停机问题非常相似
cues.en: "Do these premises entail this conclusion?" is very similar to this halting problem

cues.zh: 事实上，如果我们能解决这个逻辑问题，就能解决停机
cues.en: in fact if we can solve the logical problem then we can solve the halting

cues.zh: 问题
cues.en: problem

cues.zh: 也就是判断这个程序在这个输入下会不会停机。图灵证明的巧妙之处在于
cues.en: will this program halt on this input so the clever part of Turing's proof is

cues.zh: 他证明了任何机器，无论多么聪明，都不可能解决
cues.en: to show that it's impossible for any machine however clever it is to solve

cues.zh: 停机问题，也就是判断给定机器在给定
cues.en: the halting problem that is to tell us whether a given machine with a given

cues.zh: 输入下会不会停机。下面来看看他是怎么做到的
cues.en: input will halt or not - and here's how he did it

cues.zh: 假设我们有一台机器，或者一个程序，能帮我们解决这个问题
cues.en: let's suppose we've got a machine or a program that solves the problem for us

cues.zh: 它能解决停机问题。先不用管它怎么工作的，我们只要
cues.en: it solves the halting problem don't worry about how it works let's just

cues.zh: 把它看作一个黑盒：输入机器的描述和一个输入
cues.en: think of it as a black box taking the description of a machine and an input

cues.zh: 然后它给出答案
cues.en: and giving us an answer

cues.zh: 对，它会停机；或者不，它不会停机。先假设这种情况有可能。
cues.en: yes it will halt or no it won't halt just suppose that's possible

cues.zh: 把这台机器叫作“H”，用来解决停机问题。只要你把这台机器给我
cues.en: call that machine "h" for the halting problem - if you give me that machine

cues.zh: 我就能把它转换成另一台机器，像这样：
cues.en: I can transform it into a different machine like this

cues.zh: 我在它上面加一些额外的逻辑，让它在给出“是”的答案时
cues.en: I stick some extra bits on it so that if it gives me a yes answer

cues.zh: 永远循环下去，永远不停机。
cues.en: I make it loop forever without ever stopping

cues.zh: 另一方面，如果它给出“否”的答案
cues.en: if it gives me a no answer on the other hand

cues.zh: 它就会立刻停机。我们把这台大机器
cues.en: and it's going to halt straight away let's call that big machine

cues.zh: 整个叫作“H+”。现在我们可以问另一个问题：如果我把
cues.en: the whole thing "h+" now here's another question we can ask what happens if I

cues.zh: 整台机器输入给它自己，也就是把 H+ 放在这里，再把 H+
cues.en: feed the whole machine into itself so i'm going to put h+ in here and h+

cues.en: in here

cues.en: so the question I'm now asking is I'm feeding h+ into itself so i'm asking the

cues.zh: “H+ 接收输入 H+ 时会停机吗？”问题就出在这里了。
cues.en: question "Does h+ halt given input h+?" and here's where it all goes wrong

cues.zh: 因为如果 H+ 会停机，
cues.en: because if h plus does halt

cues.zh: 我们就得到“是”的答案，但它接着会永远循环。
cues.en: we get a yes answer but then it loops forever

cues.zh: 所以它不会停机。反过来，如果它不停机，
cues.en: so it doesn't halt on the other hand if it doesn't halt

cues.zh: 我们就得到“否”的答案，但它接着会停机。所以，如果它会停机，它就不会停机；
cues.en: we get a no answer but then it halts so if it does halt then it doesn't halt

cues.zh: 但如果它不停机，它就会停机。无论哪种情况都会产生矛盾。
cues.en: but if it doesn't halt then it does halt. Either way we get a contradiction

cues.zh: 这是个悖论。但它说明，我们一开始假设可以解决这个
cues.en: it's a paradox but what that shows is we started off assuming that we can solve

cues.zh: 问题，
cues.en: the problem

cues.zh: 最后却得出了悖论，所以我们的假设是错的。
cues.en: we've ended up with a paradox so our assumption was bad

cues.zh: 结果证明，不存在这样的机器，
cues.en: it turns out there's no possible machine

cues.zh: 也不存在能解决停机问题的程序。
cues.en: no possible program that solves the halting problem

cues.zh: 图灵这个想法真正巧妙的地方在于，机器是什么类型根本不重要。
cues.en: the really clever bit about Turing's idea is it doesn't matter what kind of

cues.en: program our machine is. It doesn't matter whether it's an abstract algorithm

cues.en: whether it's a real computer, a physical computer

cues.zh: 它是什么都不重要，我们已经证明了不可能有这样的程序
cues.en: it doesn't matter what it is we've prove that no such program as possible

cues.en: Turing as part of his argument had to say a little bit about what's going on
